command:
set -eu
NS=ufw-evidence
HOST_VETH=ufw-host
NS_VETH=ufw-ns
cleanup() { sudo -n kill "${P8080:-}" "${P9090:-}" 2>/dev/null || true; sudo -n ip netns del "$NS" 2>/dev/null || true; sudo -n ip link del "$HOST_VETH" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
sudo -n ip netns add "$NS"
sudo -n ip link add "$HOST_VETH" type veth peer name "$NS_VETH"
sudo -n ip link set "$NS_VETH" netns "$NS"
sudo -n ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev "$HOST_VETH"
sudo -n ip link set "$HOST_VETH" up
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev "$NS_VETH"
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip link set lo up
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip link set "$NS_VETH" up
python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 192.0.2.1 >/tmp/ufw-8080.log 2>&1 & P8080=$!
python3 -m http.server 9090 --bind 192.0.2.1 >/tmp/ufw-9090.log 2>&1 & P9090=$!
sleep 1
printf 'LISTENERS\n'
ss -lntp | awk 'NR==1 || $4 ~ /192[.]0[.]2[.]1:(8080|9090)$/'
printf 'ALLOWED_8080_HTTP_CODE='
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" curl -sS --connect-timeout 3 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://192.0.2.1:8080/
set +e
REJECT_OUTPUT=$(sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" curl -sS --connect-timeout 3 http://192.0.2.1:9090/ 2>&1)
REJECT_RC=$?
set -e
printf 'UNRELATED_9090_RC=%s\n' "$REJECT_RC"
printf 'UNRELATED_9090_RESULT=%s\n' "$REJECT_OUTPUT"
test "$REJECT_RC" -ne 0

set -eu

HOST_VETH=ufw-host

cleanup() { sudo -n kill "${P8080:-}" "${P9090:-}" 2>/dev/null || true; sudo -n ip netns del "$NS" 2>/dev/null || true; sudo -n ip link del "$HOST_VETH" 2>/dev/null || true; }

sudo -n ip netns add "$NS"
sudo -n ip link add "$HOST_VETH" type veth peer name "$NS_VETH"

sudo -n ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev "$HOST_VETH"
sudo -n ip link set "$HOST_VETH" up
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev "$NS_VETH"
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip link set lo up

python3 -m http.server 9090 --bind 192.0.2.1 >/tmp/ufw-final-9090.log 2>&1 & P9090=$!
